assumptions.rationale: The benchmark reached about 7.17% in late September 2026, a near two-year high, up from about 6.7% in July. Cap-rate spreads should be tested against 7.0-7.3%. On 3 November 2026 the yield eased to 7.30%, still near the highest since March 2023, as elevated crude and the RBI's calibrated-tightening stance kept pressure on; economists expect the repo rate to reach at least 6%. Base moved to 7.30% and the upper case to 7.5%. On 4 November 2026 the yield was 7.25%, down about 8 bps on the session as Brent eased towards $104; base set to 7.25%. On 5 November 2026 the yield was 7.12%, down about 12 bps on the session as crude eased; base set to 7.12%. On 6 November 2026 the yield was 7.17%, up about 4 bps on the session after touching a one-month low, with a ₹36,000 crore auction ahead; base set to 7.17%. On 9 November 2026 the yield was 7.18%, up about 1 bp on the session; base set to 7.18%. On 11 November 2026 the yield rose to about 7.21%, extending its rebound on higher US Treasury yields and concerns about extra bond supply (Trading Economics); base set to 7.21%. On 12 November 2026 the yield closed at about 7.25%, up about 4 bps on the session (Trading Economics); base set to 7.25%. On 13 November 2026 the yield rose to about 7.31%, up about 6 bps on the session, as accelerating inflation, heavy bond supply and expectations of another rate hike in early December weighed on prices (Trading Economics); base set to 7.31%. On 16 November 2026 the yield was about 7.34%, up about 2 bps on the session, as inflation above the RBI's tolerance band and heavy bond supply kept pressure on (Trading Economics); base set to 7.34%. On 17 November 2026 the yield eased to about 7.28%, down about 6 bps, as Brent slid towards $92 a barrel, though October CPI of 6.09% kept a December hike in view (Trading Economics); base set to 7.28%. On 18 November 2026 the yield was about 7.26%, slightly lower on the session and off its highest in nearly two weeks, as lower crude eased imported-inflation worries, though October CPI above 6% kept a December hike priced in (Trading Economics); base set to 7.26%. On 19 November 2026 the yield rose about 2 bps to about 7.28%, though it was down about 12 bps over the month, as markets kept pricing in another RBI rate increase in early December (Trading Economics); base set to 7.28%. On 20 November 2026 the yield fell about 10 bps to about 7.19%, as foreign investors returned to Indian government bonds and lower crude eased pressure, though inflation above the RBI's tolerance band kept a December hike in view (Trading Economics); base set to 7.19%.

news.headline: K-RERA data shows 3,145 Karnataka projects past their completion dates
news.summary: Nearly 30% of the 10,621 projects registered since 2017 are overdue, including some by BDA and other public agencies. Only about 10% of ₹1,253 crore in recovery certificates has been collected.

news.headline: Shapoorji Pallonji plans 900-acre plotted township at Khopoli
news.summary: SPRE has approval for a first 200-acre phase, targeted within three years, and sees revenue potential of about ₹6,000 crore. Around ₹1,500 crore has gone into land, funded by equity.

news.headline: Navi Mumbai civic body resists state push on cluster redevelopment
news.summary: The urban development department told NMMC to process five cluster proposals in Ghansoli and Vashi, overriding a civic freeze. The corporation voted to seek a stay pending a carrying-capacity study and may go to the High Court.

news.headline: Max Estates plans ₹4,000 crore 'The Bungalows' in Gurugram
news.summary: The luxury project will have 243 residences on 7.25 acres near Golf Course Extension Road, according to a stock-exchange filing. No launch date was given.

news.headline: KW Group buys 1.5 acres in Indirapuram for ₹134 crore
news.summary: The freehold parcel, won at a development-authority auction, has about 5 lakh sq ft of potential for an ultra-luxury project. ASK Property Fund has committed ₹150 crore.

news.headline: Mars opens 60,000 sq ft Hyderabad capability centre with Genpact
news.summary: The centre starts with over 400 Genpact staff and is planned to grow to 1,000, focused on digital, data and AI work.

news.headline: PMC speeds Holkarwadi town planning schemes to free ring-road land
news.summary: An arbitrator has been appointed for Holkarwadi TP Schemes 4 and 5, which together should yield about 19.6 hectares for the ring road. The corridor width has been cut to 65 metres from 110 metres.

news.headline: NBCC to redevelop College Street and Tangra Chinatown
news.summary: NBCC signed an MoU with West Bengal's urban development department and KMDA to execute the projects on a deposit-work basis for a 5% fee. No project cost was disclosed.

news.headline: DTCP to resume sealing of illegal PGs and hotels in Gurugram colonies
news.summary: Inspections in DLF Phases 1-5, Sushant Lok and South City are expected before a 23 November Supreme Court deadline. DTCP has so far issued 1,319 show-cause notices and 662 restoration orders.

news.headline: CBRE: quick commerce may need 75 msf of urban logistics space by 2030
news.summary: CBRE estimates about 42 msf for dark stores and 33 msf for mother hubs by 2030, against about 27 msf in use today. Quick-commerce take-up was 4.3 msf in 2025, led by Delhi NCR, Mumbai and Bengaluru.

news.headline: NBCC re-auctions 49 Sarojini Nagar flats at a 10% higher reserve
news.summary: The Avenue Towers flats are now offered at ₹40,877 per sq ft of super built-up area after NBCC cancelled the earlier highest bids. The e-auction is set for 30 November.

news.headline: BMC proposes ₹815.61 crore lease of Lower Parel asphalt plant plot to Indivara Realty
news.summary: The 11,300 sq m G/South ward plot would be leased for 30 years, extendable by 30, for residential or non-residential use; Indivara outbid Sheth Homes and Saroj Landmark against a ₹755 crore base. The Improvement Committee still has to approve it.

news.headline: MHADA plans to monetise Worli BDD plots to fund rehab housing
news.summary: MHADA proposes selling incentive FSI on a 6.24-acre residential and a 2.1-acre commercial plot in the 59.69-acre Worli BDD Chawl redevelopment. The plan needs state cabinet approval; earlier plot sales at Naigaum and N M Joshi Marg drew no bids.

news.headline: Meesho CEO buys two Yemalur villa plots for ₹83.81 crore
news.summary: Vidit Aatrey bought adjoining plots totalling 33,485 sq ft in Epsilon Residential Villas, East Bengaluru, from members of the Byju Raveendran family, about ₹25,000 per sq ft. The deeds were registered in July.

news.headline: Haryana fixes ₹4.92-8.25 crore an acre compensation for Greater SPR land
news.summary: About 160 acres across six Gurugram villages will be acquired for roughly ₹986 crore, with Badshahpur at the top rate; another 116 acres came in through TDR. Developers expect the road to lift demand along the Southern Peripheral Road and Golf Course Extension Road corridor.

news.headline: Noida RWAs cannot levy NOC fee on transfers to relatives, registrar rules
news.summary: The deputy registrar held that the 0.5% circle-rate NOC fee under the UP Apartment Act applies only to sales for money, not to adding family members to title. The order was copied to the stamp department and Noida Authority.

news.headline: Borewell ban pushes Hyderabad builders to costlier tanker water
news.summary: With new construction borewells banned from 1 November, builders estimate water adds about ₹10 per sq ft to costs. The western corridor, including Gachibowli and HITEC City, is worst hit and some mid-2027 handovers could slip.

news.headline: Vasavi Urban buyers protest delayed possession in Bachupally
news.summary: Over 1,000 buyers in the roughly 3,700-flat project, promised possession by December 2024, demanded a schedule and the interest TG RERA ordered for some complainants. They allege the orders have not been honoured.

news.headline: KMC building committee clears pending sub-40 m projects after eight-month gap
news.summary: The Municipal Building Committee met on 14 November and cleared pending applications for buildings up to 10 storeys, with structural engineers now required to attend. Developers say about 1 crore sq ft elsewhere, including New Town and Rajarhat, still awaits clearance.

news.headline: WBRERA portal back after two-month outage, leaving a filing backlog
news.summary: The portal, down since 1 October after a malware attack on the state data centre, resumed in early November. Developers who could not register projects or file quarterly reports report deferred launches and bookings.

news.headline: Tamil Nadu to post registered property deeds from a central facility
news.summary: Under the Anywhere Registration programme, deeds will be printed centrally and sent by Speed Post, with a 48-hour target for Chennai and nearby districts. Rule 109 of the state registration rules is to be amended.

news.headline: Former JLL India head launches Kaspian Partners advisory group
news.summary: Rahul Arora's group starts with AssetAdvantage, an owner-side leasing and asset advisory firm paid by retainer and performance fee rather than brokerage, in Bengaluru, Mumbai and NCR. An occupier-side firm is planned for 2027.

news.headline: Capacit'e wins ₹670 crore CIDCO housing order at CBD Belapur
news.summary: CIDCO awarded Capacit'e Infraprojects a repeat order to build about 473 three- and four-bedroom units across 10 towers on Plot 20, Sector 15A, CBD Belapur, under the MAHA Awas DRS scheme.

news.headline: Peninsula Land signs ₹775 crore redevelopment of two Versova societies
news.summary: The Ashok Piramal Group developer will redevelop two neighbouring housing societies on about 1.5 acres in Versova, Andheri West, into a gated community with an estimated GDV of ₹750-775 crore. Launch is expected in FY2027-28.

news.headline: Forest department to pay MHADA ₹1,040 crore for 6,500 Kalyan flats for SGNP rehabilitation
news.summary: Maharashtra's forest department will buy 6,500 MHADA flats at Shirdon and Kon in Kalyan, at about ₹16 lakh each, to relocate eligible families living inside Sanjay Gandhi National Park. About 3,449 residents have consented; a local MLA has opposed the distance from existing neighbourhoods.

news.headline: M3M and Jacob & Co plan ₹1,650 crore branded residences in Sector 111
news.summary: The 120-unit project in M3M's 170-acre Billionaire's Block on Dwarka Expressway targets a ₹3,300 crore topline, with units averaging 7,300 sq ft from ₹26 crore and an expected average launch price of ₹40,000 per sq ft.

news.headline: Max Estates' The Bungalows gets HARERA registration
news.summary: HARERA registered the 243-residence, two-tower project on about 7.25 acres in Sector 59 near Golf Course Extension Road on 6 November. Max Estates puts its gross development value at about ₹4,000 crore.

news.headline: Iron Hill Brewery takes 20,000 sq ft at Sumadhura Capitol Towers, Whitefield
news.summary: Sumadhura leased 20,000 sq ft of retail space at its Whitefield commercial development to Iron Hill Brewery and 3,700 sq ft to café chain Yummy Bee. Rents were not disclosed.

news.headline: IndoSpace launches ₹350 crore Narasapura-II logistics park
news.summary: IndoSpace will develop about 1.05 million sq ft of industrial and logistics space in the KIADB-notified Narasapura Industrial Area in Kolar district, on the Bengaluru-Chennai corridor.

news.headline: Knight Frank: retrofitting old offices could add ₹3.76 lakh crore in value
news.summary: About 301 msf, or 28% of top-eight-city office stock, is ageing and eligible for upgrades, with value rising 76% after retrofit. MMR shows the biggest uplift (96%) and Bengaluru the smallest eligible share (12%).

news.headline: JLL: retail leasing up 5.6% to 9.36 msf in January-September
news.summary: Leasing across seven cities was the strongest nine-month total in four years. Delhi NCR, Mumbai and Bengaluru made up about 72%, with Pune and Kolkata growing fastest.

news.headline: Telangana RERA: layout approval does not replace project registration
news.summary: TG RERA fined a Mancherial plotted-layout promoter ₹5.3 lakh for selling plots without registration, ruling that gram panchayat and DTCP layout permissions do not exempt a project from RERA.

news.headline: Signature Global consortium wins about 475 acres in Raigad for ₹194 crore
news.summary: The land in Karjat, Khalapur and Sudhagad came through the PACL asset-monetisation e-auction; Signature Global holds 65% of the bidding subsidiary.

news.headline: PMC proposes attaching 33 Sinhgad Institute properties over ₹295 crore tax dues
news.summary: The Pune civic body's property tax department wants the dues recorded against 33 Sinhgad properties, with auction possible later; earlier sealing of about a dozen properties did not recover the amount.

news.headline: Madras High Court keeps 1 km planning freeze around Pallikaranai marsh
news.summary: The court declined to lift the NGT bar on CMDA planning permissions within 1 km of the Ramsar site, sought by CREDAI Chennai, Olympia Tech Park and landowners, because wetland demarcation is pending before the Supreme Court. Petitioners may seek relief there.

news.headline: Karnataka weighs up to 30% rise in property guidance values
news.summary: The stamps and registration department's proposal, with the sharpest increases expected around Bengaluru, could take effect from 15 December or 1 January after objections; it is not yet approved.

news.headline: GYGY Group wins 2-acre Sector 135 Noida plot for about ₹135 crore
news.summary: The Noida Authority e-auction parcel is earmarked for a commercial project of about 6.5 lakh sq ft; 40% of the bid is due within 60 days and the rest over four years.

news.headline: Assetz gets Sebi observations for ₹1,200 crore IPO
news.summary: The Bengaluru developer, which filed confidentially about three months ago, reports about 550 acres and a 4.5 crore sq ft pipeline and is exploring entry into MMR.

news.headline: Elan signs Marriott for branded homes at Elan Imperial, Sector 82 Gurugram
news.summary: The 9-acre mixed-use project of about 2.5 msf will carry the Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy brand, Elan's second Marriott tie-up this year.

news.headline: Tamil Nadu lets approved non-high-rise buildings go to 19.5 m without fresh permission
news.summary: A 16 November housing department clarification to DTCP and CMDA covers buildings approved before 26 October above 16 m, capped at stilt or ground plus five; FSI, units and setbacks must not change.

news.headline: BMC offers housing societies up to 15% property tax rebate
news.summary: The rebate is split between wet-waste processing, dry-waste management and water conservation, with escalating fines and loss of the rebate for repeat waste-rule violations.

news.headline: Khan Market holds 24th place among world's costliest high streets
news.summary: Cushman & Wakefield's Main Streets Across the World 2026 puts Khan Market rents up 14% to about ₹1,875 per sq ft a month; Mumbai's Linking Road posted the fastest rent growth in Asia Pacific at 28%.

news.headline: Pecan Realty and HDFC Capital launch Mumbai commercial platform with ₹1,000 crore Andheri East project
news.summary: The first project near the airport will exceed 4 lakh sq ft of Grade A offices, retail and F&B.

news.headline: Colliers: India real estate investment up 39% in January-September
news.summary: Offices took 37% of capital and domestic investors 59%, while hospitality and alternatives grew fastest; foreign inflows rose 17%.

news.headline: Metro Satyam announces ₹450 crore One Crest in Kharghar
news.summary: The Sector 20 Kharghar project offers mainly 3 and 4 BHK homes with revenue potential put at about ₹700 crore.

news.headline: Runwal Realty plans ₹2,500 crore hotel arm with six properties
news.summary: About 1,000 keys across four business hotels and two resorts in Mumbai, Thane, Pune and Alibaug are planned over four to five years, funded 60:40 debt to equity.

news.headline: Gateway Distriparks wins eight-year mandate to run JNPA common rail yard
news.summary: The DFC-compliant terminal at Nhava Sheva handles mixed container trains, extending the company beyond its ICD and CFS operations.

news.headline: Goyal & Co puts ₹820 crore into Titanium Tech Park, Whitefield; Airbus and Caterpillar lease 1.18 msf
news.summary: The 25-acre campus is planned at about 5 msf over three phases, with 1.5 msf operational; Airbus took about 880,000 sq ft and Caterpillar 300,000 sq ft at a combined annual rent of about ₹100 crore.

news.headline: MCD clears up to 75% rebate on PM-UDAY regularisation charges
news.summary: The Standing Committee approved the cut for Delhi's 1,511 unauthorised colonies across four charge heads; the rebate does not by itself confer ownership.

news.headline: Six listed REITs distribute over ₹3,234 crore for Q2 FY27
news.summary: Indian REITs Association data put gross AUM above ₹3.3 lakh crore across about 215 msf, with more than 5.25 lakh unitholders.

news.headline: Telangana pegs Bharat Future City core infrastructure at ₹18,000 crore
news.summary: The state estimates roughly ₹5,000 crore for roads, ₹6,000 crore for water and waste and ₹2,350 crore for power across a 30,000-acre core area; the master plan is due at the Invest Global Summit on 7-9 December.

news.headline: Knight Frank: retrofitting Kolkata offices could add ₹4,800 crore in value
news.summary: About a quarter of Kolkata's 34 msf office stock is judged eligible for retrofitting, which the report says could lift its value 48% to about ₹15,000 crore, most of it in the CBD.

news.headline: South Delhi luxury floor prices up as much as 40% in the September quarter
news.summary: Golden Growth Fund says a typical 2,500 sq ft floor in colonies such as Vasant Vihar, Golf Links and Jor Bagh rose to about ₹23.75 crore from ₹17 crore a year earlier; Category B colonies gained less.

news.headline: Haryana pollution board halts work at a Godrej Properties project in Sector 3, Gurugram
news.summary: The board cited alleged Air Act violations; Godrej told exchanges it is working to restart and expects no major financial impact.

news.headline: K Raheja Corp signs JDA for 165-acre mixed-use township at Panvel
news.summary: The registered joint development agreement, reviewed by CRE Matrix, values the land at about ₹956 crore on a revenue-share basis; the mix and timeline were not disclosed.

news.headline: SRA issues revised LoI for JP Infra slum scheme in Malad East with 1,419 rehab homes
news.summary: The scheme on a 3.4-hectare plot, clubbed with an Andheri project, has sanctioned FSI of 4.77 and about 98,600 sq m of sale built-up area.

news.headline: Maharashtra Maritime Board appoints consultants for Mumbai Water Metro Phase 1
news.summary: Phase 1 covers 17 water routes linking 26 terminals across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane, Palghar and Raigad; a Tissa-RINA joint venture will manage design and supervision.

news.headline: DMRC proposes eight Phase V(B) corridors, including Yashobhoomi to Gurugram
news.summary: Seven corridors totalling about 97 km have Delhi government approval and await the Centre; the Yashobhoomi-Rajiv Chowk Gurugram link is still under consideration.

news.headline: Signature Global adds about 10 acres in Sohna to its land bank
news.summary: The two parcels, taken under collaboration agreements, carry about 0.86 msf of developable area; investment value was not disclosed.

news.headline: Greater Chennai Corporation plans ₹12 crore makeover of 5.8 km airport approach road
news.summary: The Gateway of Chennai project between the airport and Kathipara flyover covers landscaping, lighting and pedestrian works, with a six-month target.

news.headline: North-west Hyderabad residents seek Metro extension from Kukatpally to Gandimaisamma
news.summary: The representation to the Chief Minister asks for a DPR for a corridor via Chintal, Jeedimetla and Suraram in the next Metro phase.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs sees repo rate at 6.25% by mid-2027
news.summary: It expects a 25 bps hike at the 2-4 December MPC and a further 50 bps in the first half of 2027, a faster path than its October view.

news.headline: Redbrick Offices raises ₹630 crore to expand managed office portfolio
news.summary: The operator plans to grow from 6.5 msf to over 10 msf in 18-24 months across its eight-city footprint.

news.headline: Collins Aerospace breaks ground on MRO facility at Devanahalli Aerospace Park
news.summary: The state has allotted 26 acres for the propeller-systems maintenance facility, which is expected to create about 2,100 direct jobs.

news.headline: Bank of America leases about 10.1 lakh sq ft at Mindspace Cyberabad for its GCC
news.summary: BA Continuum India took the ground floor and floors 7-17 of Building 1 at ₹82 per sq ft a month for 12 years, with 15% escalation every three years, per registration documents.

news.headline: West Bengal drafts rules to scrap ground coverage caps
news.summary: A draft amendment to the municipal building rules would replace ground coverage limits with mandatory open-space norms and allow uncapped additional FAR outside hill areas; it is not yet in force.

news.headline: Karnataka targets 15 lakh free sites and approves one lakh houses
news.summary: The cabinet set a 2026-27 target of free residential sites for landless families, starting with five lakh, and cleared one lakh houses costing about ₹2,241 crore.

news.headline: Maharashtra registration offices to report cash property payments of ₹2 lakh or more
news.summary: Sub-registrars must send monthly reports of such cash components to the Income Tax Department, and the I-Sarita system will record cash and cheque payments separately.

news.headline: YEIDA allots 147 developed plots to farmers by lottery
news.summary: The draw adds to 295 plots allotted earlier in the week; about half of the roughly 4,000 plots owed to farmers have now been allotted.

news.headline: NHB proposes a ₹15 lakh affordable housing loan category for smaller cities
news.summary: The proposal for Tier-II and Tier-III cities is under consultation and does not yet change eligibility; NHB also plans 20 more RMBS deals over the next year.

news.headline: NDMC to consult stakeholders on unit-area property tax bye-laws
news.summary: Draft bye-laws would assess tax on covered area, age, use and location; consultation with RWAs and market associations is set for 23 November.

news.headline: County Group and Elate Realtors sign ₹830 crore JDA for 24.7 acres in Noida Sector 150
news.summary: County Group plans a luxury housing launch in December 2026 and will also build two public sports complexes in the Sports City project.

news.headline: Shriram Properties Q2 profit rises about 2.5 times to ₹21.6 crore
news.summary: Total income for the September quarter grew to about ₹272 crore from ₹229 crore a year earlier.

news.headline: Domicil opens a luxury furniture showroom at Spacio Tower, Kolkata
news.summary: The German brand, part of HTL International, is expanding its eastern India footprint; store size was not disclosed.

news.headline: Keystone Realtors plans ₹5,000 crore of MMR launches by March
news.summary: H1 FY27 bookings rose 11% to ₹2,041 crore; the Rustomjee developer targets ₹5,000 crore of bookings for the year, with redevelopment a core focus.

news.headline: Devgn CineX to open 34,000 sq ft multiplex at KB West Walk Mall, Greater Noida West
news.summary: The five-screen, roughly 737-seat cinema will anchor the upcoming mall by Shree KB Group; terms were not disclosed.

news.headline: AGM Vijaylaxmi launches 32-storey Sixty3 W.E. Residences in Goregaon East
news.summary: The tower offers only 2 BHK homes; no unit count or project price was disclosed.

news.headline: Address Maker sells over 200 plots at Apollo Address, Nelamangala, in six weeks
news.summary: About 100 villa plots of 1,200-2,400 sq ft remain in the 23-acre phase of a 90-acre township.

news.headline: Tamil Nadu sanctions ₹45.5 crore for a master plan of the expanded 5,904 sq km Chennai Metropolitan Area
news.summary: The funds, spread over three years, will also finalise the Third Master Plan for the existing 1,189 sq km area; CMDA will hire an international consultant.

news.headline: Design unveiled for Mumbai International Cruise Terminal at Indira Dock
news.summary: The PPP terminal with JM Baxi pairs cruise operations with retail, hospitality and event space to keep the waterfront active off-season.
